output.title: landing: `check:tests-enforcing` fails from #6563 (c2aaaaaaa)
output.observation:
## Observation

`landing:watch` runs `check:tests-enforcing` on the head `fffffffff` of `landing`, and the check fails. It passes on `eeeeeeeee`, the last green head.

The search over the first parents names `c2aaaaaaa` as the first commit where the check fails. Pull request #6563, "fix(core): read a declined pair", brings it, so the claim goes to the lane `reduction`.

The failing lines:

```text
[check:tests-enforcing]   FAIL gandr-core-checker judgement::tests::pair
```
